entries.description: Kick-off and scoping: reviewed the export archive and agreed the capture points.
Analysed representative CDS export files and catalogued the active report templates.
Set up the rendering service skeleton and the development environment.
Implemented the report layout engine for the two most common templates.
Review call with the client team; walked through the first rendered samples.
Extended the layout engine to the remaining templates and fixed pagination issues.
Implemented the archive integration: rendered PDFs written next to the source export.
Job keying and duplicate handling; reprocessing path for failed capture jobs.
End to end test run against the staging archive; logged and triaged findings.
Resolved the findings from the staging run and hardened the error handling.
Client review of the staging results; agreed the acceptance criteria.
Acceptance test support and defect fixes during the client test window.
Drafted the operator runbook: deployment, health checks, batch reprocessing.
Handover session with the operations team, including a runbook walkthrough.
Final cleanup, versioned release build, and project closure notes.

notes: All hours were recorded against SOW 261912. Travel time is not included.
